title: Relight · looks on a portrait
description: The Relight tool's Generate lighting (Qwen-Image 2.1 + Viggle's 6-step speed LoRA, words written from the placed lights by src/lib/relight/lights.ts) on 12 portraits you supply in local/relight/<id>.png: 8 editorial portraits and 4 more. Each case runs the four named looks, and Golden hour and Studio rim with their softness said once. Measures identity against the photo (the acceptance bar is 0.85 on every portrait at 100 %, median 0.90), CLIP and aesthetic. Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo (8 steps) and Qwen-Image-Edit 2509 with its Relight LoRA run the same words for comparison: run one variant at a time (--variants viggle, then turbo-today, then edit-2509-relight) so each engine loads once. Where a light lands is its own suite (relight-placement). The guide-picture, Pruna 8-step and r128 arms change the graph itself, so they run as graphs of their own and are recorded next to this suite. Stray colour cast, background edges and the alignment residual are measured from the aligned results with the tool's own maths (src/lib/relight/align.ts, blend.ts).
decides: The default engine variant, the softness wording, the blend mode and the look tuning (RELIGHT_SETTINGS in src/lib/relight/engine.ts).

viggle.description: Generate lighting as the tool runs it: Viggle 6-step r256, the photo and the words only

turbo-today.description: Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo (8 steps), the same words

edit-2509-relight.description: Qwen-Image-Edit 2509 with its Relight LoRA (the app's composer route), the same words
